svg.title: Fold layouts of KFold, GroupKFold and TimeSeriesSplit
svg.desc: Three grids of ten samples in rows of three splits each. KFold uses contiguous test blocks, GroupKFold keeps pairs of samples with the same group together in the test fold, and TimeSeriesSplit with gap 1 trains on the past, skips one sample and tests on the following two.
svg.text: Which samples train and which test in each split (10 samples)
a group never straddles train and test
train on the past, skip a gap, test on the next block
